verdicts.reason: Both share the same broken layout. The original's diamond photo mosaic is reduced to one small rectangular photo plus an empty wireframe of diamond outlines in the top right, and an orphaned rule sits under it. The two brown diamonds float on their own, the body copy is tiny, and the URL is crammed against the right edge. A sits close to the headline and roughly lines up with the photo's left edge, so headline and copy read as one group. B floats the body copy out into the middle, where it lines up with nothing and leaves a dead gap next to the headline.
